mechanisms.name: Protocol Assistance Fund buybacks
mechanisms.note: The cumulative total is reconciled. It includes a 17,987,320.50473923 HYPE opening balance on 2025-03-22, which is not a single transaction. Transaction-level Assistance Fund tracking starts on that date because available archive fills start then and the live API retains only the latest 10,000 fills.

mechanisms.name: HyperCore null-address burns
mechanisms.note: Complete from HYPE's genesis: every HYPE transfer into the HyperCore zero and dead addresses from Hyperliquid's official ledger, then daily balance readings from 1 October 2026. Together they equal the addresses' HYPE balances exactly. One 0.001 HYPE transfer that the daily spot dusting removed on 1 December 2024 is not counted.

mechanisms.name: HyperCore protocol burns
mechanisms.note: The cumulative total is exact: Hyperliquid's own HYPE maxSupply minus totalSupply. Everything destroyed on HyperCore from genesis on 29 November 2024 through 30 September 2026 is one 1,104,483.93233325 HYPE opening balance read at 00:00 UTC on 1 October 2026. It is not a single transaction, and no official source splits it by day. Daily amounts start on 1 October 2026.

mechanisms.name: HyperEVM gas burns
mechanisms.note: Complete HyperEVM gas-burn history from launch: official requester-pays S3 block-and-receipt objects provide checksum-verified archive coverage and continuous bounded live indexing with no open gaps.
